issues.description: The problem statement requires a method countBooks() -> Int that returns the number of books. The solution implements countBooks() with signature func countBooks() (returning Void) and prints the count instead of returning an Int. This mismatch between the specified return type and the solution's implementation is structural: students following the spec would implement and/or expect a method that returns an Int, and automated tests may check for that signature/value. As a result, students may be confused about the expected method contract and tests that expect an Int return will fail.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the Bookstore API conform to the problem specification by changing the method signature to return an Int: func countBooks() -> Int { return books.count }. Update any callers (or tests) that currently expect printing behavior to use the returned Int instead. If the printing behavior is deliberate, update the problem statement to specify that countBooks() should print the count (i.e., return type Void) to avoid confusion.
